# Centerspace Announces Quarterly Dividend


Company Release -


09/03/2026


Download the PDF version PDF Format (opens in new window)


MINNEAPOLIS


, Sept. 3, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Centerspace's (NYSE: CSR) Board of Trustees has declared a regular quarterly distribution of $0.77 per share/unit, payable on October 14, 2026, to common shareholders and unitholders of record at the close of business on September 29, 2026.


About Centerspace
*Centerspace is an owner and operator of apartment communities committed to providing great homes by focusing on integrity and serving others. Founded in 1970, as of August 31, 2026, Centerspace owned 47 apartment communities consisting of 10,456 homes located in Colorado, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, and Utah. Centerspace was named a Top Workplace in 2026 by USA Today and for the seventh consecutive year in 2026 by the Minnesota Star Tribune. For more information, please visit*[www.centerspacehomes.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4766945-1&h=833440685&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centerspacehomes.com%2F&a=www.centerspacehomes.com) *.*


If you would like more information about this topic, please contact Justin Ziegler, Investor Relations, at (952) 401-6600 orir@centerspacehomes.com .
